title: Prove exact four-plane COPY mass 16 for one open class (no new κ)
body:
## Summary

Scoped proof with a finite exact certificate: the previously uncertified quadruple `(0,1,44,49)` in Ryanson Jonathan's #4454 has exact additive full-plane COPY mass **16**, over every coefficient field and with any finite number of scalar rank-one messages. Coordinate messages attain it. No new kappa is claimed.

```text
Every closure block: rank_K G[S,T] <= binary tariff t(S,T)
Phi(u v^T) = A_u G A_v^T
Phi(I_8) = I_16
16 <= sum_j rank Phi(u_j v_j^T) <= sum_j t(S_j,T_j)
```

The new contribution is one explicit integral witness and its consequence for this open object. The expanded-identity/Hadamard rank method retains Philippe Van Velzen's credit; the lifting route retains DreamingOfClouds #2111 and the related #3505 discussion. Credit Ryanson Jonathan #4454/#4421, CubeJerry #4365, Cinna Davis #1825/#2126, Gonzalo Mier #3990/#3997 and the retained paired-plane/E8/native lineage. Produced by Nick Petalas.

## Evidence

Before: the pinned #4454 index assigns zero to lexicographic quadruple position 1369, `(0,1,44,49)`.
After: the new checker certifies all 225 ordered closure pairs, 697 vanishing integer minor checks and 6,400 literal atom shadows. The eight-coordinate attaining endpoint, a ten-term cancelling endpoint, six rejection controls and a free-cross-atom control pass. The integer minors prove the all-field rank upper bounds; finite coefficient sampling is only corroboration.

Both direct warning-strict commands passed locally in about 0.34 seconds each. Both registered commands, metadata/pins and exact committed-byte/source-history checks pass at `04f2f504c626e79d080a0836b2e0ca8207a610e4`. Official committed export/integrity validation and read-only normal/optimized Git-free replays pass; all six exported files, including the export manifest, remain byte-identical. In-memory compilation and bounded-code inspection pass. Environment: CPython 3.12.15, macOS 27.0.1 arm64; standard library only.

From the repository root:

```sh
/Users/nick/git/integer-mult-bounds/.venv/bin/python3.12 -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/four-plane-integral-shadow
/Users/nick/git/integer-mult-bounds/.venv/bin/python3.12 -B scripts/check_research_commit.py --package research/four-plane-integral-shadow --check-source-history
/Users/nick/git/integer-mult-bounds/.venv/bin/python3.12 -I -B -W error research/four-plane-integral-shadow/verify.py
/Users/nick/git/integer-mult-bounds/.venv/bin/python3.12 -I -O -B -W error research/four-plane-integral-shadow/verify.py
```

Any CPython 3.12 interpreter can replace the absolute local path. Expected scientific marker: `PASS_FOUR_PLANE_INTEGRAL_SHADOW`, with `minimum_mass=16`. The generated receipt binds all five package files and both ordered result streams. Exact base, source blobs and SHA256 pins are in `SOURCES.json`.

[Advance claim](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/discussions/1166#discussioncomment-19146140); [scope update](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/discussions/1166#discussioncomment-19146177). The predicted characteristic-three result strengthened to every field using the same first integral witness. Research stopped at that witness.

## Limitations

This is one identity endpoint under the unchanged whole-plane additive tariff. Other quadruples, strict fitting endpoints, shared native calls and concave power bills are unclassified. Preparation, coefficient execution, routing, frames, arbitrary-dirty restoration, stock, precision, recursive/outer admission and a full supplier remain unpriced and unrun. No selected-frontier change, independent human review or formal proof-kernel acceptance is claimed. Lean, Docker, the selected cold replay and historical scientific suites were not run.

The historical card control fails at `KeyError: 'complex_profile'` under the selected schema. The current `research_selected_baseline.py` orientation passes. This mismatch does not enter the new certificate.

## Open next questions

- Name one remaining uncertified quadruple and seek a signed or rational block matrix satisfying all its closure bounds. This witness provides no general four-plane classification.
- Specify a different actual caller endpoint and compute its rank under this map. Source/consumer ownership and the complete native bill remain blockers.

## Related open work

No other open PR in the refreshed account list studies this specified four-plane identity or its integral certificate. The pre-DONE refresh found two account PRs opened since the CLAIM, including this one. The other, #5238, proves a trace-zero quadratic-support bound on E7; it has a different object and supplies no competing four-plane COPY mass. No common numerical quantity disagrees, and no extra predecessor computations were run.

Merged #4454 supplies the open remainder; merged #4421/#4365 cover earlier triple/pair rank duals. The original 348-PR scan, active claims, distinctive all-main searches and merged-PR searches found no competing certificate. Unpublished work, arbitrary diffs and omitted sparse notes remain search limits.

The run is completed/success and its head SHA matches. Registered replay executes both warning-strict normal and optimized VERIFY.json commands.

All local checks listed above also passed. CI certifies execution of the bounded certificate and controls; it does not supply independent human or formal proof-kernel acceptance of the written theorem. No Lean, Docker, selected cold replay or historical scientific suite was run.

## Merge Danger

**Door:** two-way. This isolated package can be reverted independently.

**Blast Radius:** package. Five new files; no shared code, frozen evidence or selected-frontier changes.
